Provident Real Estate proudly presents this one of a kind 4-Bedrooms Villa for Sale in Yasmin, Arabian Ranches 2. A rare opportunity to own a family home in one of Dubai's most prestigious and greenest communities.

Key Property Highlights:
.
Huge Plot 8,361 sqft
BUA 4,350 sqft
4 beds + Maid’s
5 Bathrooms
En-suite bathrooms
Double Height Ceilings
Type 2 Corner Unit
Closed Kitchen
Upstairs Family Lounge
Laundry/Storage Room
Huge Garden
Well Maintained
Motivated Seller
Vacant

Community Features Yasmin, Arabian Ranches 2:

Premium gated community by Emaar
Landscaped parks and walking trails
Swimming pools, tennis & basketball courts
Ranches Souk, restaurants, and retail nearby
International schools and nurseries within the community
Quick access to Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan & Umm Suqeim Rd


For more information or to book a viewing please contact your Tarek, your area specialist today.
